metadata.title: Design Implementation Plan
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Design a comprehensive implementation plan for implementing or updating a concept across non-code files. Creates detailed change proposals for modifications and new file creation.

output.description: Implementation plan document with change proposals

prerequisites: Findings report with current state analysis
specificActions: Read Context from Previous Steps: Read from memory.json (concept definition, findings, gaps); read from process.md (conceptDescription, requestedState, verificationCriteria); read the findings report to understand current state

Understand Requested State: If requestedState parameter provided, use as specification; if NOT provided, derive from concept description and characteristics; document requested state specification clearly
Analyze Existing State and Gaps: Review findings report from previous step; identify files that need modification vs. creation; map gaps to change proposals needed
Design Implementation Approach: Break down into logical steps; determine order of changes (dependencies); design verification approach

Create Change Proposals: For modifications (MOD-XXX): Change ID, file path, type, current/requested state, instructions, rationale; for new files (NEW-XXX): Change ID, file path, type, content specification, rationale
Present Plan and Get Approval: Present implementation-plan.md to user; explain approval options; wait for user response; log user interaction before processing
tools: read_file - Read context from memory, process, findings, target files
bestPractices: Be specific: Change proposals should be detailed enough for next step to apply without ambiguity
Consider dependencies: Order changes to avoid breaking things
Provide rationale: Explain why each change is needed
Keep proposals atomic: Each proposal should be self-contained
Use consistent IDs: Makes it easy for user to approve specific proposals

substeps.name: Init-Step: Confirm Principles
substeps.description: Recall operating principles before starting this step
actions: Read `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md` and recall all principles
Output: '✓ Principles confirmed for this step'

substeps.name: Read context from memory.json
substeps.description: Read concept definition, findings, and gaps from memory
actions: Read memory.json to get concept definition from previous step
Get findings report path
Understand gaps identified

substeps.name: Read process parameters
substeps.description: Extract conceptDescription, requestedState, verificationCriteria from process.md
actions: Read process.md to get conceptDescription
Get requestedState parameter if provided
Get verificationCriteria parameter

substeps.name: Read findings report
substeps.description: Read findings report to understand current state
actions: Read findings report file
Understand current state analysis
Note gaps and areas needing changes

substeps.name: Understand/derive requested state
substeps.description: Determine the target state for files after implementation
actions: If requestedState parameter provided: Use as specification
If NOT provided: Derive from concept description and characteristics
Document requested state specification clearly

substeps.name: Analyze gaps and map to proposals
substeps.description: Map identified gaps to specific change proposals needed
actions: Review gaps from findings report
Identify files that need modification
Identify files that need to be created
Map each gap to a change proposal

substeps.name: Design implementation approach
substeps.description: Design the overall approach for implementing changes
actions: Break down into logical steps
Determine order of changes (dependencies)
Design verification approach

substeps.name: Create modification proposals
substeps.description: Create change proposals for existing file modifications
actions: For each file needing modification, create a proposal with:
Change ID (MOD-XXX), file path, type: modification
Current state description
Requested state description
Detailed instructions for making the change
Rationale for why change is needed

substeps.name: Create new file proposals
substeps.description: Create change proposals for new files to be created
actions: For each new file needed, create a proposal with:
Change ID (NEW-XXX), file path, type: new_file
Content specification (what should be in the file)
Rationale for why file is needed

substeps.name: Create implementation-plan.md
actions: Create implementation-plan.md with all change proposals
Include requested state specification
Include implementation approach
Include verification approach

substeps.name: Present plan to user
substeps.description: Present implementation plan and explain approval options
actions: Present implementation-plan.md to user
Explain approval options: approve all, approve specific IDs, request modifications, reject
Wait for user response

substeps.name: Process user response
substeps.description: Handle user's approval, modification request, or rejection
actions: Log user interaction IMMEDIATELY before making any changes
If approved: Note which changes are approved (all or specific IDs)
If modification requested: Revise proposals and re-present
If rejected: Document rejection reason

substeps.name: Update memory with approval status
substeps.description: Update memory.json with plan summary and approval status
actions: Write to memory.json current step section
Include: implementation plan path, total proposals, files to modify/create
Include: approval status, list of approved Change IDs

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Verify: Do modified process files conform to type definitions? (Principle 7 - see `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md`)
Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Read context → Read parameters → Read findings → Understand requested state → Analyze gaps → Design approach → Create proposals → Create plan document → Present for approval → Process response → Update memory

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Previous steps (concept definition, findings, gaps), process.md parameters
fields: Information Produced: Implementation plan path, Requested state specification, Total change proposals count, Files to modify/create lists
Decisions Made: Implementation approach, Change proposal priorities
Approval Status: Approved/Pending/Rejected, List of approved Change IDs
